source_issues.title: 先修编号和模型/流程强断言
source_issues.note: 源先修06称Vectors & Matrices、14称Probability Distributions，与固定数学课程06概率/14范数距离不符，照源保留。所有ASR/TTS必经过mel、每个错误仅三类、所有模型固定采样率以及Whisper-Large-v4等型号/2026库优劣是源断言，未核实时效。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent bounded reading/math inspection; no source correction or external research.
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload retained faithfully; no mandatory translation correction.

source_issues.title: 波形格式和声道数
source_issues.note: 波形不总是一维归一化浮点数组；多声道、整型及超范围浮点均依格式/接口。soundfile/torchaudio的输出shape/dtype与配置不同，sf.read示例显式dtype=float32不能推定任何默认读取均float32。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent bounded reading/math inspection; no source correction or external research.
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload retained faithfully; no mandatory translation correction.

source_issues.title: Nyquist边界、抽取和理想滤波器
source_issues.note: 无歧义采样需带限/采样等条件，Nyquist恰好等号可能有相位歧义。8kHz并非丢失所有辅音或完全不适用于ASR。brick-wall是理想滤波器，实际ADC/DAC并不都配理想砖墙；混叠频率示例还可能有相位符号变化。
source_issues.verification_scope: 有限7000Hz/10000Hz采样与负3000Hz正弦一致至1e-12，正频DFT峰在3kHz。未设计/修改滤波器。
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload retained faithfully; no mandatory translation correction.

source_issues.title: PCM范围和float32精度
source_issues.note: signed int16范围为-32768到32767，不是对称±32767；24位有效二进制精度不同于在[-1,1]均匀量化24位绝对精度，浮点值也不被类型限制在该区间。
source_issues.verification_scope: 有限整数边界/量化级计算；源±32,767和24-bit文字保护不改。
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload retained faithfully; no mandatory translation correction.

source_issues.title: DFT模、幅度、频点与负频
source_issues.note: 未经归一化的DFT模不等于原信号幅度；负频索引需要环绕解释。频率一般不落整数频点，440*N/sr可为非整数并产生泄漏，不能要求每种N恰好有该索引。
source_issues.verification_scope: N8单位幅度正弦对应正/负频模4；N256,sr16000,440Hz理想索引7.04，实际正频峰7即437.5Hz。Parseval归一化有限核验通过。
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload retained faithfully; no mandatory translation correction.

source_issues.title: FFT长度与实信号频点计数
source_issues.note: FFT并非都要求2的幂，源混同常见基2实现和所有FFT。1024实序列含DC和Nyquist的非负频点为513；说512覆盖0到8kHz端点不清。15.6Hz为15.625Hz的取整近似。
source_issues.verification_scope: 只用有限索引算术得到513及15.625，不安装FFT包。
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload retained faithfully; no mandatory translation correction.

source_issues.title: 分帧加窗和频谱图概念
source_issues.note: 可对整段做FFT，短时分析只是语音常用选择。窗函数减少泄漏不保证消除边缘不连续，Hamming端点非零。STFT复系数与频谱图模/功率显示不是同一对象；25/10ms为典型约定。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent bounded reading/math inspection; no source correction or external research.
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload retained faithfully; no mandatory translation correction.

source_issues.title: 示例上下文与有限运行边界
source_issues.note: DFT片段使用前段math，顺序共享上下文。生产读clip.wav示例依soundfile和本地输入，非allowlist未运行。O(N^2)只有限N<=256执行，不跑整秒16k样本DFT。canonical程序未由本独立审阅读或执行。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent bounded reading/math inspection; no source correction or external research.
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload retained faithfully; no mandatory translation correction.

source_issues.title: 练习计算量与混叠可观察性
source_issues.note: 1秒16kHz混合信号直接纯PythonDFT是二次大计算，本次不跑。语音降采样混叠是否明显依原频谱，不能保证每段录音出现；抗混叠与朴素抽取应从同一原始48k音频比较，译文明确原音频未改实验角色。matplotlib/torchaudio未安装运行，也未录制用户音频。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent bounded reading/math inspection; no source correction or external research.
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload retained faithfully; no mandatory translation correction.
